-# classify_observations: adds HEALTH_OBS's records to FAILED_CHECKS,

-# of a tick classify the same way).
-classify_observations() {

   while IFS=$'\t' read -r kind name verdict ms reason; do
     [ "$kind" = obs ] || continue
     case "$name" in route:*) routes=$((routes + 1)) ;; esac
@@ -262,36 +255,6 @@ EOF
   fi
 }

-# `run` logs it: OK, INDETERMINATE [names] or FAIL [names] indeterminate=(names).
-checks_verdict() {
-  if [ ${#FAILED_CHECKS[@]} -eq 0 ] && [ ${#INDETERMINATE_CHECKS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
-    printf 'OK\n'
-  elif [ ${#FAILED_CHECKS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then
-    printf 'INDETERMINATE [%s]\n' "${INDETERMINATE_CHECKS[*]}"

-  fi
-}
-
-# keep_observations <observations> <epoch> <verdict>: after a pass has
-# decided (nd_recovery_tick returned 0), $(nd_platform_state_dir)/
-# observations.tsv becomes its records plus `pass <epoch> <verdict>` (0600,
-# renamed over from a temporary file in the same directory, so a reader never

-# failure is logged; the pass goes on.
-keep_observations() {
-  local d t
-  if d="$(nd_platform_state_dir)" && nd_state_init 2>/dev/null && t="$(mktemp "$d/.observations.XXXXXX")"; then
-    if { cat "$1" && printf 'pass\t%s\t%s\n' "$2" "$3"; } >"$t" && chmod 600 "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$d/observations.tsv"; then
-      return 0
-    fi
-    rm -f "$t"
-  fi
-  log_to_file "$(ts) observations not kept in ${d:-the state directory}"
-  return 0
-}
-
 # redact_bridges: diagnostics never carry bridge material (PRIV-NO-SECRETS):
 # certificates, fingerprints and bridge addresses are replaced.
 redact_bridges() {
@@ -443,11 +406,11 @@ cmd_run() {

+  log_to_file "$now FAIL [${FAILED_CHECKS[*]}]${INDETERMINATE_CHECKS[*]:+ indeterminate=(${INDETERMINATE_CHECKS[*]})} -> $dump"
   run_controller_pass "$now"
   return 1
 }

 }
 
 run_controller_pass() {

     log_to_file "$now_human controller skipped: no valid observations"
@@ -540,10 +503,7 @@ run_controller_pass() {
   fi
   o="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/nice-dns-obs.XXXXXX")" || return 0
   printf '%s\n' "$HEALTH_OBS" >"$o"
-  epoch="$(date +%s)"
-  out="$(nd_recovery_tick active "$o" 2>&1)"; rc=$?
-  # Only a pass that decided (busy or a broken state decides nothing).
-  [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] || keep_observations "$o" "$epoch" "$(checks_verdict)"
+  out="$(nd_recovery_tick active "$o" 2>&1)"

   log_to_file "$now_human controller $(printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -F '\t' 'NF == 2 { printf "%s%s=%s", s, $1, $2; s = " " }')"
 }

 # what it would do, in a separate shadow state), commit. The schedules still

 cmd_tick() {

   fi

-  epoch="$(date +%s)"
